a1-unit-28.28.1 Rio:
Narrator: It's Friday. Paulo is in Rio de Janeiro for a photo job. Listen to his busy day.
Woman: Good morning, and welcome to Rio! Here's your room key. Do you have any questions?
Paulo: Yes. What time does breakfast start?
Woman: It starts at six thirty, on the first floor.
Man: Good morning! Can I help you?
Paulo: Did you make this cheese bread today?
Man: Yes, we did. We make it every morning at five o'clock.
Woman: Hello! Can I help you?
Paulo: Yes, please. Do you have something for a headache?
Woman: Yes, we do. Take one of these after lunch with some water.
Paulo: Excuse me. Why did the machine keep my card?
Man: Because you typed the wrong password three times. Don't worry, we can help you.
Paulo: I want to send this package to São Paulo. Which is faster, SEDEX or PAC?
Woman: SEDEX is faster, but it's more expensive.
Paulo: Hi! I'm here for the photo shoot. Who usually answers the phone here? Nobody answered this morning.
Man: Bia usually answers the phone, but she's on vacation this week. Sorry about that!
Paulo: Excuse me. Who painted this picture? It's beautiful.
Woman: Candido Portinari painted it in nineteen thirty-five. It's called Coffee.
Paulo: I know I'm late, but when did the movie start?
Man: It started ten minutes ago. Do you want to go in?
Paulo: Yes, please! What a day!
